nodes.title: Users can export their posts as CSV
nodes.description:
Serves R1-R3 in docs/factory/csv-export/requirements.md.

## Success Criteria
- A signed-in user downloads a CSV of their posts from the Posts page
- The file opens in Excel and Google Sheets with correct columns and encoding
- Export of 10k posts completes in under 10s
nodes.design: Streamed response from a new route handler; no new storage. See design.md §3.

nodes.title: CSV serializer for posts
nodes.description: Pure function turning Post[] into RFC 4180 CSV. Serves R2.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Columns: id, title, status, scheduled_at, channel
- Commas, quotes and newlines in titles are escaped
- UTF-8 with BOM
- Unit tests cover empty list, escaping, unicode
nodes.design: New file src/lib/export/csv.ts + test. No other files.

nodes.title: GET /api/posts/export streams the user's posts as CSV
nodes.description: Authenticated route using the serializer. Serves R1, R3.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- 401 when signed out
- Only the caller's posts are returned
- Content-Disposition sets a dated filename
- Integration test covers auth and ownership
nodes.design: src/app/api/posts/export/route.ts. Reads through the existing post repository.

nodes.title: Export button on the Posts page
nodes.description: Button that triggers the download. Serves R1.
nodes.acceptance_criteria:
- Button visible on /posts for signed-in users
- Click downloads the file
- Disabled with a tooltip when the user has no posts
